what: What the on-device recogniser (Vosk, vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15, run inside the page) wrote down when a Windows synthetic voice spoke each sentence into it through a fake microphone in desktop Chromium, with the word list the app listens with. Scripts: tmp/voice-sim.py and tmp/voice-sim3.py against the production build on Nov 6 and 7, 2026. Not a real voice and not the headset microphone.
